page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Expose the minimum configuration surface needed to understand and operate Infrastructure Manager safely: read deadlines, retention floor, theme and locale. Configuration here tunes how the instrument reads — never what it reads against.

priorities.statement: Nothing on this page can change the setpoint.
priorities.notes: Deadbands, actuators and targets are operator decisions made through an approved reliability-target-update in the team's plan of record. A settings control that touched them would let the instrument grade itself against a bar it chose.

priorities.statement: The retention floor is presented as a correctness constraint, not a preference.
priorities.notes: Retention below the longest declared target window silently converts a measurable target into an unmeasurable one. The page must say so rather than offering it as a free choice.

claims.statement: Settings exposes no control that creates, edits or deletes a target, deadband or actuator.
claims.rationale: The setpoint is owned by the team and the operator. Deviation D6 — an observer authoring its own reference model — is confirming itself.

claims.statement: Lowering retention below the longest declared target window warns that specific targets will become unmeasurable, and names them.
claims.rationale: Silently trimming evidence below the window a target is banded on is indistinguishable from the target passing.
